_comment: Example of eva/profile.json (app/core/profile.py). Copy to /opt/eva/eva/profile.json on the device and fill in your household. The names here are made up.

location._comment: Roughly where the home is: web search answers for this place (prices, shops, weather). All fields optional.

services._comment: Every service defaults to http://{hub}:<port>. Override one: "stt": "http://other-host:8901/stt". Env EVA_<NAME>_URL wins over both.

tuning._comment: Any value from the code, by module.name (see the profile.tune(...) calls). Only what differs from the defaults. Env EVA_<MODULE>_<NAME> wins.

databases._comment: Databases Eva reads with SQL (skill data). dsn = the key of the connection string in /etc/eva/secrets.env; give her a read-only role. needs: known | adult | admin.
databases.name: home
databases.about: smart home: devices and rooms, sensor history (temperature, humidity, motion), energy

artist._comment: Skill artist (app/skills/artist): the pictures API, OpenAI-compatible (/images/generations, /images/edits). All keys optional, these are the defaults. key = the name of its key in /etc/eva/secrets.env.

voices._comment: Her voice per avatar (app/say.py): ascii | image | eq | live2d, default for the rest. engine xai (XAI_API_KEY, voice = XAI_VOICE) or elevenlabs (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, voice id, model).
